quote: Something essential is lost here—it no longer feels like a true Grand Theft Auto game. Despite the big scale, the soul and attitude of the franchise feel watered down.

author: Filip9
quote: Pure freedom in a vast, living world. Breath of the Wild lets you create your own adventure without limits. Easily one of the greatest games ever made on Nintendo.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

author: Filip9
quote: Ocarina of Time sparks your imagination at every turn. While it may be more accessible and easier than modern games, its timeless magic makes it even more worthy of being called the greatest.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
